result.fundName: Axis Small Cap Fund - Direct Plan - Growth

insights: Axis Small Cap Fund - Direct Plan - Growth decisively outperforms its benchmark on rolling returns by 5.00% (21.50% vs 16.50%).
Beat the benchmark in 80.7% of rolling windows — strong consistency for a Equity: Small Cap.
Risk-adjusted returns are superior: Sharpe 1.20 vs benchmark 0.77, Sortino 1.39.
Defensive profile: beta 0.70 with 24% lower volatility than the benchmark.
Positive alpha of 8.13% suggests manager skill beyond market exposure (info ratio 0.34).
Higher drawdown risk: fund max drawdown -34.64% vs benchmark -59.78%.
Rolling return range spans 4.98% to 35.09% (30.11 pp spread) — consistency score 88.
This fund satisfies all three Golden Triangle conditions.
